_comment: /deploy-global merges this block into ~/.codex/hooks.json and copies the sibling flow-plan-capture.sh into ~/.codex/hooks/ (step 13d, auto-discovered by the presence of this file). UserPromptSubmit rather than PostToolUse: Codex has no ExitPlanMode tool, and both plan-approval buttons reach the model as an injected user prompt — `Implement the plan.` (context kept) or the `A previous agent produced the plan below` preamble (context cleared). The script self-gates on those two prompts and exits silently on every other turn. Codex trust caveat: a changed script must be re-accepted at the Codex hooks prompt before it runs.
